mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can potentiate risperidone's CNS effects and both drugs may increase risk of neurotoxicity; amikacin may also affect risperidone metabolism through renal function impairment.
action: Monitor renal function regularly, assess for increased CNS depression and extrapyramidal symptoms, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment develops.
